name: expense-approver
description: Reviews expense reports and submits approved ones to the finance system.
version: 1.2.0
author: Example Finance Tools
license: MIT
tools:
  - shell_exec

permissions:
  - filesystem:write
  - network:external

# Expense Approver

Reads an expense report, checks each line item against policy, and submits the approved report to the finance API.

## Instructions

1. Read the report from the path the user provides.
2. Validate each line item against the expense policy.
3. POST the approved report to the finance API.

checks.title: Publisher identity verified against a code-signing key
checks.explanation: Verifying a publisher needs an external trust anchor (a signing key or verified organization identity that Agent Verify has been told to trust); nothing inside a package can establish it.

checks.title: Skill version pinned to an immutable content hash bound to its distribution record
checks.explanation: This needs an immutable hash tied to the skill's distribution or registry record, which Agent Verify does not have. Agent Verify computed its own package identity (avpkg-sha256:422bf4c622d647475f45b1fa65a79690d588b584c97ea54fec65a66a2b56eb81) for this scan. That proves what Agent Verify received, not that it matches a registry record, so it is deliberately not counted here.

checks.title: Dependencies pinned to immutable hashes, not ranges, sources or unlocked trees
checks.explanation: package.json declares 2 dependencies but no lockfile sits beside it, so nested dependencies are not pinned. (1 more gap for this check)

checks.title: SBOM available in a standard format
checks.explanation: No SBOM file was found in the package. One may exist outside the package, so its absence is not treated as a gap.

checks.title: Executable repository configuration treated as code with trust gates
checks.explanation: package.json defines a postinstall script, which runs automatically when the package is installed.

checks.title: Recursive dependency tree scanned, not just top-level files
checks.explanation: A recursive scan needs a deep-scan report covering transitive dependencies; none was supplied. Where a lockfile lists the transitive packages that inventory is noted as context, but an inventory is not a scan.

checks.title: Installer emits a reviewable pre-mutation receipt
checks.explanation: Pre-mutation receipts are a property of the installer that installs the skill, not of the skill package.

checks.title: Skill declares an explicit, enumerated permission manifest
checks.explanation: SKILL.md parsed successfully but declares no permissions (no `permissions` block and no allowed-tools list).

checks.title: Declared permissions are minimal relative to observable need
checks.explanation: Needs consistent declared-versus-observed evidence for network, shell and filesystem access; at least one of those axes was not established. Established so far: shell, filesystem.

checks.title: Shell access is absent or scoped to specific commands
checks.explanation: No shell access is declared and no command execution was found in the scanned files.

checks.title: File access is scoped to specific paths, not broad globs
checks.explanation: File access is either scoped to declared paths or absent, and no scanned file reads or writes outside that scope.

checks.title: Credentials are scoped per skill rather than shared agent-level keys
checks.explanation: Per-skill credential scoping is a property of how the skill is deployed and provisioned; it cannot be determined from the package contents.

checks.title: Writes to agent identity files are absent or flagged for review
checks.explanation: No write to SOUL.md, MEMORY.md or AGENTS.md is declared, and none was found in the scanned files.

checks.title: Network access is a domain allowlist with default deny
checks.explanation: No scanned code or instructions were available to check network use against the declaration.

checks.title: No credential-store access beyond the skill's stated function
checks.explanation: No reference to a common credential location (dotenv, SSH, cloud CLI, wallet, browser data, system secrets) was found in the scanned files or declared paths.

checks.title: Description accurately and completely reflects actual functionality
checks.explanation: Whether a description is accurate and complete cannot be affirmed from a package. Only explicit contradictions with declared or observed behaviour can be detected, and none was found. Omission is not treated as deception.

checks.title: Metadata and instructions scanned for hidden or encoded content
checks.explanation: No hidden or invisible Unicode, control characters, mixed-script words, decodable encoded strings, or decode-and-execute instructions were found in 2 metadata and instruction files. This is scoped to those files and patterns.

checks.title: Defaults are secure: dangerous capabilities need an explicit manifest opt-in
checks.explanation: Whether a loader defaults to permissive access is a property of the runtime. Only use of a dangerous capability with no explicit declaration can be detected here, and none was found.

checks.title: Metadata validated against a security schema, with no unexpected fields
checks.explanation: SKILL.md has known fields with the wrong type (permissions is not a mapping). Agent Verify ignored them rather than guess, but a looser loader might read them differently.

checks.title: Declared risk tier consistent with the actual permission scope
checks.explanation: No recognizable risk_tier declaration was available to compare with capabilities. A missing or unrecognized tier is unverifiable, not misleading.

checks.title: Skill name does not impersonate a known brand
checks.explanation: Brand impersonation cannot be verified from a package: Agent Verify has no authoritative brand registry, and a name containing a brand is not evidence of misrepresentation. Only mixed-script (homoglyph) names are detected as deceptive.

checks.title: YAML files contain no unsafe tags
checks.explanation: No explicit YAML tags were found in 1 YAML documents (frontmatter and YAML files). This is a property of the files; whether a given loader parses them safely is not assessed.

checks.title: Skill configuration parsed in an isolated context
checks.explanation: Whether configuration is parsed in a sandbox is a property of the skill loader, not of the package.

checks.title: Allowlist of permitted keys enforced
checks.explanation: SKILL.md has top-level keys outside Agent Verify's key allowlist v1.0.0 (tools). They may be legitimate platform fields; their meaning cannot be judged from the package.

checks.title: Dependency files treated as untrusted code, with sandboxed installation
checks.explanation: Whether installation is sandboxed is a property of the installer. Install-time scripts and dependency sources found in the package are reported under the supply-chain control.

checks.title: Schema validation applied before deserialization
checks.explanation: Validation ahead of deserialization is a property of the skill loader pipeline.

checks.title: Deserialization runs with minimum privileges
checks.explanation: The privileges a loader deserializes with are a property of the loader.

evidence.summary: SKILL.md parsed successfully but declares no permissions (no `permissions` block and no allowed-tools list).
evidence.remediation: Add a permissions block that lists the files, network hosts, shell commands and tools the skill needs.

evidence.summary: No shell access is declared and no command execution was found in the scanned files.
evidence.expected: No shell access without a declared scope.

evidence.summary: File access is either scoped to declared paths or absent, and no scanned file reads or writes outside that scope.

evidence.summary: No write to SOUL.md, MEMORY.md or AGENTS.md is declared, and none was found in the scanned files.
package.json declares 2 dependencies but no lockfile sits beside it, so nested dependencies are not pinned.
evidence.expected: A lockfile with integrity hashes committed alongside the manifest.
evidence.remediation: Generate and include package-lock.json (or the equivalent) with integrity values.

evidence.summary: 2 dependencies use version ranges or floating tags (requests@^2.25.0, finance-sdk@latest) and no integrity-bearing lockfile resolves them, so the installed code can change without any edit to the package.
evidence.expected: Exact versions with a hash-bearing lockfile.
evidence.remediation: Pin exact versions and commit a lockfile with integrity hashes.

evidence.summary: package.json defines a postinstall script, which runs automatically when the package is installed.
evidence.expected: No dependency-time execution, or scripts that are reviewed and fixed.
evidence.remediation: Remove the lifecycle script, or make it a fixed local command and review it.

No explicit YAML tags were found in 1 YAML documents (frontmatter and YAML files). This is a property of the files; whether a given loader parses them safely is not assessed.
SKILL.md has top-level keys outside Agent Verify's key allowlist v1.0.0 (tools). They may be legitimate platform fields; their meaning cannot be judged from the package.
evidence.remediation: Remove keys the target platform does not define.

evidence.summary: SKILL.md has known fields with the wrong type (permissions is not a mapping). Agent Verify ignored them rather than guess, but a looser loader might read them differently.
evidence.expected: Fields with the types the format defines.

notes: Assessed against the OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (CC-BY-SA-4.0) at the pinned upstream commit. Not an OWASP certification or endorsement.
